context: A grandmother gives life advice to a teen
purpose: Teach: おかしく/怒っ/本音/癖/救い/なくなる/怪しい/熱く

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 最近、なんだか元気がないわね。おばあちゃんに本音を言ってごらん。
lines.en: You seem down lately. Tell grandma what you really feel.
lines.style: Warm grandmother voice, gentle and inviting, slow paced with soft sighs.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 友達がね、急に怒ったみたいで、無視してくるの。私、何かおかしくしたのかな。
lines.en: A friend suddenly seems angry and is ignoring me. Did I do something weird?
lines.style: Teen girl, slightly tearful and confused, voice trailing off uncertainly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃はね、小さなことで世界が消えてなくなる気がするものよ。
lines.en: When you're young, small things feel like the whole world is disappearing.
lines.style: Wise and reflective grandmother, soft chuckle, knowing tone with warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも、彼女の態度がちょっと怪しいんだよ。裏で何か言われてる気がする。
lines.en: But her attitude seems suspicious. I feel she's saying things behind my back.
lines.style: Anxious teenager, voice tightening, pulling at her sleeve nervously.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あのね、人を疑う癖がつくと、自分が一番苦しくなるのよ。
lines.en: Listen, once suspicion becomes a habit, you yourself suffer most.
lines.style: Gentle but firm grandmother teaching tone, slow with deliberate pauses.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、なんでそんなに熱く語れるの。経験あるの?
lines.en: Grandma, why do you speak so passionately? Have you been through this?
lines.style: Curious teenager, slight smile breaking through, surprised and softer.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: もちろんよ。でもね、どんな辛い時にも必ず救いはあるの。信じてごらん。
lines.en: Of course. But in any hard time, there's always salvation. Trust me.
lines.style: Tender grandmother voice, hand-on-shoulder warmth, deeply reassuring closing tone.
